roles.name: Shipper / customer
roles.description: The account that books shipments and orders and tracks their delivery.

provenance.notes: karrio's OwnedEntity model scopes records to a customer/organization; single source.

roles.name: Dispatcher
roles.description: Plans routes and assigns drivers and vehicles to orders.

provenance.notes: Reasoned from fleetbase's dispatch/route/waypoint schema; no explicit role model inspected, single source.

roles.name: Driver
roles.description: Operates a vehicle to execute pickups and deliveries, using the mobile app.

roles.name: Warehouse staff
roles.description: Handles inbound receiving, outbound consolidation, and label/parcel handling at a facility.

provenance.notes: Not modeled explicitly in either cloned source; reasoned from the domain brief and the general warehouse-operations role implied by GS1 supply-chain event roles.

roles.name: Fleet manager
roles.description: Owns vehicle assets, maintenance schedules, and fuel/compliance for the fleet.

provenance.notes: Reasoned from fleetbase's vehicle/maintenance schema; single source.

roles.name: Operations manager
roles.description: Oversees day-to-day shipping/delivery operations, carrier relationships, and exception handling.

provenance.notes: Reasoned from both platforms' admin-level carrier/rate configuration surfaces.

roles.name: Customer support agent
roles.description: Handles customer inquiries about tracking, exceptions, returns, and claims.

roles.name: Carrier / vendor
roles.description: The external carrier or vendor providing rates, pickup, and tracking updates.

provenance.notes: karrio's carrier snapshot on Shipment and fleetbase's fleetbase_vendors/vendor_personnels tables both model an external carrier/vendor party.

roles.name: System / webhook
roles.description: Automated actor that ingests carrier webhook events and telemetry to update tracking and vehicle location.

provenance.notes: karrio's webhook-driven tracking updates and fleetbase's device_events/telematics tables both imply an automated ingestion actor.
